scope: Published exhibit discovery metadata for Kerala-located schools in thirteen NCERT national catalogues,2010–2019 and2022–2024. The audited catalogue entries are not an exhaustive Kerala exhibition history, proof of attendance, prizes or a Kerala DGE qualifying route.
transcription_policy: Published titles/codes/school-address spellings retained, with layout whitespace joined. No synopses, pupil names, teacher names or personal contact details are copied into this discovery index. Continuation pages and address-only school fields remain explicit.

catalogue_reviews.review_method: All English synopsis-table school-address columns reviewed in page order using full text plus coordinate-based columns; all Kerala candidates checked against the complete corresponding table-page text. Exhibit codes were used for reconciliation, not to infer qualifying routes. Representative/boundary pages were rendered and visually inspected.

review_methods.2010–2017: Titles, exhibit codes and school-address spelling are retained from the source, with layout whitespace collapsed. No synopses, student names or teacher names are reproduced. Hindi counterpart pages are not separately counted. Printed-page fields identify the first page of a row; any continuation is listed in pdf_pages_1based and location_evidence.
2018–2024: Extracted every PDF page with pypdf and audited every English Student/Students/Student(s) credit and school/address block; cross-checked exhibit-code pages and all pages containing English School/Teacher text for unmatched credit layouts.

Reviewed 815 English school/address blocks across five catalogues, rather than relying only on literal Kerala matches. Scanned addresses for Kerala districts/cities and state spelling variants; separately checked ambiguous adjacent-territory entries.

Reviewed complete candidate page text for exact exhibit titles, codes, school/address strings and printed-page mappings. No school-system qualifying route was inferred from catalogue code or location.

Visually checked the complete representative and boundary pages listed per catalogue, including the Kerela typo, missing school name at Kochi, 2022 no-space Student: format and Lakshadweep entry, and Mahe/Puducherry exclusion.

ambiguities_and_exclusions.detail: The top Kerala-691526 line on PDF 52 completes Safety Boat (14.02) from PDF 50. It is not the state of Robot - 2010 (16.02), whose following school address is Narayangaon/Pune. Only one Kerala record spans these pages.
The published title Water Paper Recycling and school-address spelling Katambashi Puram are retained. No correction to Waste Paper or a modern institution name is inferred.

The Mahe school rows explicitly print Puducherry: Kasturba Gandhi Government High School, Naluthara (35.2) and Jawaharlal Nehru Government Higher Secondary School (35.3). They are excluded from Kerala-location counts.
Kerala/Muvattupuzha in the cover and preface is the national host location, not school attribution. Only school-address table rows establish entries in this index.

Parabolic Curves (16.2.15) lists Brilliant Study Centre, Mutholy, Kottayam, Kerala in the school-address column. It is retained as published; institutional recognition or eligibility is not independently established.
Mahe/Pudducherry and Kavaratti/Lakshadweep school rows remain separate from Kerala even where names or proximity might suggest a connection.

K.T.C.T. Innovative Billing Control System (16.2.2) is separated from the following Government Zal Seva Niketan, Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh row (17.2.1). Both codes and school columns were checked visually.
The Kalpeni school explicitly prints Lakshadweep and the Mahe school explicitly prints Puducherry; neither is counted as Kerala.

SMV Higher Secondary School, Poonjar/Kottayam, Third Eye for the Blind (16.3.1) is separated from the preceding Karnataka SJES oil-recovery row (15.3.1). Both school-address columns were checked visually.
Government Senior Secondary School, Kottungal, Teh-Kotli, Dist-Mandi explicitly prints H.P.-175003; it is not counted as Kerala.

ambiguities_and_exclusions.reason: School addresses explicitly identify Minicoy, Kalpeni or Kavaratti in Lakshadweep; Kerala-like PIN prefixes do not place them in Kerala.
Government Senior Basic School, Amini is explicitly in Lakshadweep.
School address explicitly identifies Mahe, Puducherry; it is excluded from Kerala state location despite geographical proximity and PIN 673310.

remaining_gaps: A source catalogue listing does not prove attendance, Kerala DGE nomination, a particular Sasthrolsavam placing, or independently verified performance.
This discovery audit covers the thirteen named catalogues; additional books, original school reports and actual Kerala delegation lists remain outside it.
The 2023 code42.2.1 source omits its institutional school name. Retain the address-only attribution until another primary record identifies the institution.
Names of student/teacher contributors and contacts are intentionally omitted from this discovery dataset; preserve attribution through the linked primary source when producing detailed case studies.
The2022catalogue audit identified no confident Kerala school entry; this is not a finding that Kerala did not participate in the national event.
The years2020,2021,2025and2026 have no synopsis catalogue link in the inspected English archive. The2020/2021 national exhibitions are separately documented as a combined virtual event.
Source metadata can contain mistaken spellings/PINs; no school identity or location was inferred from a Kerala-like PIN alone.
